meta.name: pi-goal
meta.description: Persistent Codex-style goal tracking for pi. Use when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让助手持续跟踪长期目标，可随时查看和调整进度。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望让AI助手记住并持续推进你的长期目标。
copy.tagline_en: Keep your assistant on track with long-term goals, pause or resume anytime.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to remember and keep working on multi-step goals.

howto.what: 装上后，当你要长期跟踪某件事时，Claude 会用内置工具创建目标并记录进度；当你表示目标完成或预算用完时，它会先核实现状再更新状态，未核实前不会标记为完成。
howto.when: 当你明确提出跟踪一个长期目标（设置、继续、审计等均属此类），或当已有进行中的目标时触发。

say.text: 帮我建立一个目标：完成产品上线准备。
say.note: Claude 会创建目标并开始跟踪进度。

say.text: 查看当前目标进行到哪一步了。
say.note: Claude 会用工具读取并汇报进度状态。

say.text: 这个目标已完成，请核实并标记。
say.note: Claude 先核实现状，通过后才标记完成。

howto.what_en: Claude can track long-running goals: you ask to create one, and it stores the objective and records progress. When you report a goal as done or the token budget is exhausted, it audits the actual state before updating the status; it won't mark complete if work remains.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask to track a long-running goal (setting, continuing, auditing, etc.), or when an active goal already exists.

say_en.text: Set a goal: finish preparing the product launch.
say_en.note: Claude creates the goal and starts tracking it.

say_en.text: How far along is my current goal?
say_en.note: Claude fetches the goal and reports its progress.

say_en.text: This goal is done; please verify and mark it complete.
say_en.note: Claude checks actual evidence, then marks complete if valid.
